reviews.review:
Ok, re-re edit after my partner and I became the first ones to finish the game.
This game is a true example of excellence in writing, graphics, design, and puzzles with a powerful message and a philosophy that I don’t just find beautiful, but one I honestly think we should all share.

The Travelers is a game about solving a mystery, a puzzle, uncovering the story of what happened, exploring, gathering materials, cooperating with others, stealing, fighting, building.
With the simplicity of its design, it completely pulls you in always making you wonder what else happened, what the next step is.
The items, the inventory, the materials everything hits that perfect balance of simplicity and complexity that makes it incredibly engaging without ever feeling “grindy.”

Here, there is only excellence.
In my opinion, it’s a masterpiece. A hidden gem.

I truly hope everyone who reads this manages to finish the game.
